description: Evaluate API Rate Limit & Throttling under 20 concurrent queries
steps: Execute 20 parallel requests to askChatbot() and measure rate limit handling
expected: API handles rate limits gracefully without unhandled crashes; successful responses latency < 3000ms
actual: 20 succeeded, 0 rate-limited (HTTP 429), 0 errors. Total time: 584ms, Avg Success Latency: 445.05ms

description: Process 10000 sequential data fetch queries under high memory load
steps: Execute 10000 iterations of course data querying and measure heap memory delta
expected: Processing completes in < 1000ms, heap memory delta < 15MB
actual: Processed 10000 queries in 1ms. Memory Heap Delta: 0.06 MB

description: Inject burst of 100 emergency alert payloads simultaneously
steps: Generate and structure 100 emergency alert payloads with high data volume
expected: Burst payload generation completes under 200ms without memory leak

description: Evaluate app state handling under network throttling (50ms - 300ms delay)
steps: Simulate high latent networks (3G / degraded 4G) and verify non-blocking execution
expected: App handles delays gracefully without uncaught promise rejections
actual: Simulated network delay total 683ms. Non-blocking state preserved
